edbDesc: Adiabatic heating occurs when the pressure of a gas is increased from work done on it by its surroundings, e.g. a piston. Diesel engines rely on adiabatic heating during their compression stroke to elevate the temperature sufficiently to ignite the fuel.
title: Adiabatic Heating
pickWhy: The same effect as Adiabatic Cooling run the other way; both go on one card kept in this batch.
